constants:
set -euo pipefail
actual=$(python -c 'import tomllib;print(tomllib.load(open("pyproject.toml","rb"))["project"]["version"])')
if [ "$actual" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
  echo "::error file=pyproject.toml::tag says '$EXPECTED' but the tree is stamped '$actual' — refusing to publish a mislabelled image"
  exit 1
fi
echo "ok: tree and tag agree on $actual"
